# AXEL Persistent AI Docs Plan

## Objective
Build a durable AI knowledge and governance layer so future agent chats stay consistent with AXEL design/implementation/lore, and automatically record implemented requests into a centralized changelog.

## Source Consolidation Scope
I will consolidate guidance from:
- Plans and design docs in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_design.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_design.md), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_implementation.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_implementation.md), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_notes.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_notes.md), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_analysis.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_analysis.md), and [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_SCENES_BLUEPRINT.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_SCENES_BLUEPRINT.md)
- Style/lore sources in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/html/game.html](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/html/game.html), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/html/styles_game.css](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/html/styles_game.css), and [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/html/styles.css](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/html/styles.css)
- Exports and engine references in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/README.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/README.md), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/GODOT_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/GODOT_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md), [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/game_data.json](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/game_data.json), and Moon Princess captures under [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/moon_princess_files](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/exports/moon_princess_files)
- Core Godot combat logic in [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd) and related combat scripts

## Files to Create
- [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md)
  - Canonical AI memory document with:
    - Project north-star and decision hierarchy (which docs override others)
    - Gameplay architecture split (narrative JSON flow vs Godot combat flow)
    - Combat invariant rules (state machine, line logic, wild/multiplier/free-spin semantics)
    - Style/lore canon (visual language, typography, tone, world facts, terminology locks)
    - Source-of-truth mapping by subsystem
    - “Do/Don’t” consistency checklist for future edits
- [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_CHANGELOG.md](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_CHANGELOG.md)
  - Structured append-only log for implemented requests only
  - Entry template: date, request summary, files changed, behavior impact, tests/verification run
- [C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc)
  - `alwaysApply: true`
  - Rule enforcing:
    - Read `AI_DOCS.md` before substantive AXEL edits
    - Keep terminology and mechanic invariants aligned
    - On successful implementation, append `AI_CHANGELOG.md`
    - If conflict between sources appears, resolve by hierarchy and document it

## Rule and Memory Flow
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    userRequest[UserRequest] --> agentWork[AgentImplementsChange]
    agentWork --> verifyStep[VerifyBehaviorAndScope]
    verifyStep --> docsCheck[CheckAIDocsHierarchy]
    docsCheck --> changelogAppend[AppendAIChangeLogEntry]
    changelogAppend --> consistentFuture[ConsistentFutureChats]
```

## Canonical Hierarchy to Encode
Priority order to reduce drift:
1. `AI_DOCS.md` synthesized invariants
2. Combat implementation constraints in `AXEL_combat_implementation.md`
3. Combat/narrative intent in `AXEL_combat_design.md` and `AXEL_notes.md`
4. Prototype style/lore evidence from `game.html` + CSS
5. Export captures and reference bundles (reference-only unless explicitly promoted)

## Changelog Operating Rules
- Add entry only when the requested change is actually implemented
- One entry per implemented request (or grouped if done in one atomic implementation)
- Include exact changed file paths and a short rationale
- Include verification notes (tests run or manual checks)
- Never rewrite old entries; only append and correction-note forward

## Validation After Implementation
- Confirm rule file is loaded and always-applying
- Confirm docs include Moon Princess reference boundaries and engine logic split
- Confirm at least one initial changelog seed entry format exists
- Spot-check consistency against current combat and style files

*** Add File: C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md
+# AXEL AI Docs
+
+Persistent guidance for AI agents working in this repository. This file is the canonical memory layer for consistency across chats.
+
+## 1) Purpose
+
+- Keep implementation decisions consistent across exploration, narrative, and combat work.
+- Prevent drift between design intent, code behavior, and visual/lore direction.
+- Provide a stable hierarchy for conflict resolution when multiple docs differ.
+
+## 2) Scope
+
+Applies to changes in:
+
+- `AXEL/axel_project/plans/*`
+- `AXEL/axel_project/combat/*`
+- `AXEL/axel_project/exports/*`
+- `AXEL/html/*`
+- `AXEL/axel_project/scenes/*`
+- `AXEL/axel_project/scripts/*`
+
+## 3) Canonical Source Hierarchy
+
+When two sources conflict, resolve in this order:
+
+1. This file: `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md`
+2. `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_implementation.md`
+3. `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_design.md`
+4. `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_notes.md`
+5. Prototype style/lore evidence in `AXEL/html/game.html`, `AXEL/html/styles_game.css`, `AXEL/html/styles.css`
+6. Exported references in `AXEL/axel_project/exports/*` and `AXEL/axel_project/exports/moon_princess_files/*`
+
+If you intentionally choose a lower-priority source for a task, record the reason in `AI_CHANGELOG.md`.
+
+## 4) Architecture Split (Do Not Blur Layers)
+
+### Narrative/prototype layer
+
+- `AXEL/html/game.html` + `AXEL/axel_project/exports/game_data.json` define choice-based story flow, flags, memories, and ending logic.
+- `AXEL/axel_project/exports/GameManager.gd` is the narrative runner model/reference.
+
+### Combat layer
+
+- `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd` orchestrates combat state and spin lifecycle.
+- Combat is Moon Princess inspired, but implemented as native Godot scripts/resources.
+- Files in `AXEL/axel_project/exports/moon_princess_files/*` are reference captures only, not authoritative runtime logic.
+
+## 5) Combat Invariants
+
+Keep these rules stable unless explicitly asked to redesign:
+
+- Combat grid is 5x5 and driven through deterministic RNG patterns.
+- Wins are line-based row/column runs of 3+ contiguous symbols (no flood-fill cluster wins for main resolution).
+- Wild spawn rule: only winning lines of exactly 3 can spawn a wild in the middle cell.
+- Multiplier progression is tied to cascade/drop progression, not arbitrary per-line increments.
+- `combat_root.gd` remains the orchestration point for spin -> resolve -> cascade -> power -> checks.
+- Princess/premium alias map is fixed:
+  - `cigarette` -> Storm
+  - `booze`/`alcohol` -> Star
+  - `bloody hand` -> Love
+- Terminology lock from notes:
+  - Regular Free Spins = Trinity Run
+  - SUPER Free Spins = later bonus mode
+  - If a request says only "Free Spins", clarify intended mode before changing behavior.
+
+## 6) Style and Tone Canon
+
+Primary style direction:
+
+- Palette baseline: black + blood red (`#ff0000`) + dark blood (`#4a0000`).
+- CRT/scanline/glitch/shake aesthetics are core identity, not optional decoration.
+- Typography center: VT323 (Space Mono may be used for supporting text where explicitly needed).
+- UI and narrative mood: dread, guilt, memory corruption, morally uneasy wins.
+- Big wins should read as unsettling/intrusive, not purely celebratory.
+
+Known source conflict guidance:
+
+- If symbol gameplay needs additional colors for readability, keep broader UI frame in AXEL palette and note exceptions.
+- If any title strings differ (for example AXEL vs GUILT in legacy exports), prefer current project naming in active gameplay files and document transitional naming in changelog entries.
+
+## 7) Lore/World Consistency
+
+Keep these narrative anchors coherent across edits:
+
+- Setting: decaying school, guilt-driven return, locker as hub/sanctuary.
+- Core progression motifs: memories, key items (Flashlight/Key/Shovel/Name), basement confrontation.
+- Axel identity reveal and ending logic remain central to branching outcomes.
+- Cigarettes/lighter ritual and memory cues are recurring thematic devices.
+
+## 8) Implementation Guardrails
+
+- Treat plans as design truth; treat code as behavior truth; reconcile both before changing mechanics.
+- Avoid introducing machine-absolute paths in shared gameplay code.
+- Keep deterministic behavior for systems intended to be replayable/testable.
+- Prefer additive, scoped changes over broad rewrites.
+- When changing one subsystem, verify cross-effects on:
+  - story flags/memories/endings
+  - combat goals/economy
+  - style/thematic presentation
+
+## 9) Agent Workflow Requirements
+
+For substantive AXEL requests:
+
+1. Read this file first.
+2. Check relevant source docs for the touched subsystem.
+3. Implement changes.
+4. Verify behavior (tests or explicit manual checks).
+5. Append one entry to `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_CHANGELOG.md` if change was implemented.
+
+## 10) Consistency Checklist (Quick)
+
+Before finishing:
+
+- [ ] Terminology and mechanics match current canon.
+- [ ] No architecture-layer mixing without intent.
+- [ ] Style/lore choices align with AXEL identity.
+- [ ] Conflicts were resolved using hierarchy and documented.
+- [ ] Implemented request was appended to `AI_CHANGELOG.md`.
*** End Patch
